finding.before: A keyless (pre-fix) approval retried with a changed/absent caller idempotency key while its reservation lease was active had the journal key resolved from the caller key, found no record under that key, released the possibly-started effect to APPROVED and re-executed the tool, orphaning the original EFFECT_STARTED journal record. The same asymmetry existed in #recoverExpiredReservation.
finding.after: Both recovery helpers resolve the durable identity before touching the journal. A keyless approval never re-arms: only CONFIRMED replays (no new effect); every other state denies operation_uncertain and the original journal record is untouched. A persisted key re-arms/releases only with positive proof (absent + never EXECUTING, or a no-effect terminal record); EFFECT_STARTED/RESERVED/UNCERTAIN, lookup failure, ambiguous binding or keyless absence deny without re-executing. The TTL sweep behavior is unchanged.

change: #denyRecoveryUncertain(): centralized fail-closed denial (operation_uncertain); marks UNCERTAIN only when the reservation cannot progress

#recoverExpiredReservation(): lookup failure denies; keyless absence/ABANDONED denies; persisted absence releases only when the approval never reached EXECUTING; EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN unchanged (mark + deny)

#recoverActiveReservation(): reads the journal under the resolved key before any reserve; keyless records replay only CONFIRMED and otherwise deny without journal mutation; persisted EFFECT_STARTED/RESERVED -> operation_in_progress, UNCERTAIN -> mark + deny, absent + EXECUTING -> deny uncertain; re-arm only for CONFIRMED replay, no-effect terminal records or absent + never EXECUTING
Both helpers deny operation_uncertain when the journal record is bound to a different proposalHash (ambiguous identity)
reserveBinding()/persistedOperationKeyFor(): test fixtures can now persist an operationKey and reserve without markExecuting, so safe recovery paths stay covered

guarantees: A keyless legacy approval can no longer re-execute an effect through any in-turn recovery path: the journal is not mutated and the denial is operation_uncertain.
The original EFFECT_STARTED journal record (possibly under a changed caller key) is never orphaned or hidden by recovery.

A persisted operationKey re-arms/releases only with positive proof under that key (absent + never EXECUTING, or no-effect terminal states); EFFECT_STARTED/RESERVED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED, lookup failure or ambiguous state never re-execute.
Replay of CONFIRMED records is preserved and cannot duplicate an effect.
The TTL sweep behavior fixed in P1-2 is preserved and re-verified by the reviewer's own frozen probes (9/9).
No existing test was weakened: the adjusted fixtures remain persisted-key positive paths or were converted to stricter fail-closed expectations.
